# dgVoodoo2 2.86.2 runtime files

This directory contains only the unmodified x86 runtime files required by
Deathtrap Dungeon:

- `x86/DDraw.dll`
- `x86/D3DImm.dll`

They come from dgVoodoo2 2.86.2 by Dege. The control panel and unrelated
wrappers are intentionally not included.

Official project: https://github.com/dege-diosg/dgVoodoo2

Official documentation and redistribution terms:
https://dgvoodoo2.dege.freeweb.hu/dgVoodoo2/ReadmeGeneral/

dgVoodoo permits individual files to be shipped with a game or game mod. See
the repository-level `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` for attribution and hashes.
